dates: business timestamps UTC ISO-8601 milliseconds; localDate kept as separate business field
money: integer minor units (cents) plus explicit currency
nullVsAbsent: preserved distinctly; no implicit zero defaults

arrays.causalEvents: preserve event sequence and tie-break by eventPriority then sourceEventId

references: validate tenant/scenario/type and resolve canonical stable keys before hashing; strip environment-specific ObjectIds only after successful reference validation
hashStreaming: sort logical records by stable key and stream canonical bytes into SHA-256; do not load all tickets in memory

parityStates.PASS: all required checks executed with zero business differences, no orphan/cross-tenant refs
parityStates.FAIL: one or more business differences or integrity violations
parityStates.BLOCKED: required access/evidence/check unavailable; never report partial PASS
